 New prediction market traders can use the  Kalshi  promo code NYPMAX55 to trade $25, to get up to a $55 bonus for Giants vs. Commanders.
 Five weeks after their first meeting ended in a 27-27 stalemate, the Giants and Commanders renew their rivalry with NFC East implications at stake.
 The Giants are favored by just 1.5 points despite the Commanders having outgained them 6.3 to 4.9 yards per play in their first meeting .

 The Over at 42.5 points warrants consideration, as the Giants rank dead last in opponent red-zone touchdown conversion percentage, while Washington sits 29th.
